repos_data.description: An implementation of Actor, Publish-Subscribe, and CSP models in one rather small C++ framework. With performance, quality, and stability proved by years in the production.
Event loop friendly C++ actor micro-framework, supervisable
[Go]Distributed Actor/Grain framework for Golang with goodies

C++20 production HFT system and order book simulator. Turn-key execution algorithm (percentage-of-volume) that follows natural order flow. Queue-position-aware order book simulator, MDP3 decoder, iLink 3, PCAP replay, custom actor framework with overhead of a few nanoseconds. Same strategy code in backtesting and live trading.
